lines.text: I'm Rocco. I run this farm.
And I have a plan for everything.

shots.note: Rocco v2 (refs/characters/rocco_ref.png); Veo spoke the lines itself, re-voiced as Rocco
Veo spoke 'We can fix anything!'; re-voiced as Rocco

video.description: ROCCO (v2): a cheerful tall cartoon rooster with an orange-red body, a long neck and a red face, big round expressive eyes with blue irises, a large yellow beak, golden scalloped chest feathers, a teal tail, and a woven straw hat with a red band, in front of the red barn.
